items.headline: Minicucci throws for 5 TDs, breaks Delaware's career passing TD record in win over New Mexico St.
items.description: — Nick Minicucci threw three of his five touchdown passes to Scott Moore and broke Delaware's all-time passing touchdown record to help the Blue Hens beat New Mexico State 42-30 on Saturday to become bowl eligible.
